name: Ready Cable Inc. - Post Tension, Rebar, & Lumber
old_description: Ready Cable Inc. was founded in 1988 with the goal of providing quality products, excellent customer service, quick turn around, and the best value pricing to concrete contractors. Over the years the business has grown to supply and service both the residential and commercial construction community, catering to projects as small as paving and to projects as large as high-rise buildings.
about:
Ready Cable Inc. is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, and was founded in 1988 by Robert “Bob” Lemke and his wife, Virginia “Jenny” Lemke. The couple’s roots in concrete go back to 1972, when they started Lemke Concrete in Illinois. After harsh winters prompted a move to Dallas in 1984, they identified a market gap for post‑tension cable materials and services and launched Ready Cable Inc. four years later. The business remains family‑owned and operates multiple yards across the Dallas‑Fort Worth metroplex, Greater Houston, Austin and San Antonio.

The company manufactures and supplies post‑tension cables, reinforcing steel (rebar) and lumber for concrete reinforcement. Its service side includes estimation and detailing for conventional and post‑tension slabs, jobsite delivery of foundation packages, professional stressing of post‑tension systems, and repair of those systems. The operation serves both residential and commercial projects, from driveway paving to high‑rise foundations.

Customers are primarily concrete contractors and builders in the residential and commercial construction sectors. Ready Cable’s packages have been used on projects ranging from single‑family home slabs to multi‑story commercial towers throughout Texas. The firm also works with its sister company, Nortex Foundation Design, which provides engineered foundation plans when clients lack shop drawings.

The Lemkes started Ready Cable to control the quality and availability of post‑tension materials for their own contracting work, a mission that evolved into a broader commitment to quick turnaround, competitive pricing and reliable field support for other contractors.
